skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator (LCD) and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract whole number parts (including from mixed numbers) and combine with the fraction part.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the subtrahend's fraction, convert one whole unit into a fraction with the same denominator, add to the fraction, and subtract.

skills.name: Simplify mixed number
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction within a mixed number to a proper mixed number by adding the whole number from the fraction to the existing whole part.

skills.name: Write whole as mixed
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction part having the same denominator as the subtrahend.
